change: Bluetooth page: a finished battery query goes straight onto the rows instead of waiting for the next 2 s device read. Wi-Fi page: opens on the list saved by the last scan (wifi-last-latest.bin in the panel directory: names, signal, security, saved flag; no passwords), the first scan ending replaces it, and the list is read every 250 ms during a scan. rootCause.Battery: The query took about 40 ms, but its result was only copied onto the rows by the next device read, 2 s later.
rootCause.WiFi: Before a scan the WLAN service list held the connected network only (1 BSS; WinRT report 1). After a scan: 16 BSS. The old note that the list is there on opening was wrong on this machine. The panel process lives for one hover, so nothing survived in memory.
rootCause.Icon: The Dock's BitmapImage for MinerU is 120x120 with artwork about 30 px wide (96 of 384 in the sample), a size consistent with about 72 px on a 256 px canvas, plus a faint frame at the canvas edge seen in the user's screenshot. Measure rejected it as a tiny placeholder (Status 3). Why Explorer gets this image is not established: the same image-list calls in another DPI-aware process return full 256 px artwork, and it survives an Explorer restart, SHCNE_UPDATEITEM and SHCNE_ASSOCCHANGED. MinerU.exe's icon group has a single 256x256 PNG entry, unlike the other pinned apps; a lead, not verified.
